entities.name: Tymaret
entities.description: Undead Returned warrior known as the Murder King, de facto leader of Odunos and champion of Erebos.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of Death who gave Tymaret a cursed blessing.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God who escaped the Underworld, sought by Tymaret.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God whose champion Daxos was instructed to remove other gods from Meletis.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City where traces of other gods were removed.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Tymaret defended Theros.

events.summary: Erebos restored Tymaret as a Returned to slay Phenax and return him to the Underworld.
events.quote: he was restored to the mortal world as a Returned, with the task of slaying Phenax

events.summary: Erebos chose Tymaret to become a demigod and lead his forces.
events.quote: The God of the Death chose Tymaret

events.summary: Tymaret fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Tymaret fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.quote: to become a demigod and serve as the leader of his forces
the de facto leader of Odunos
